name: ss33
description: ss33 Skill Store for Codex: project-aware skill search, native skill install with a lockfile, and prompt matching.

interface.longDescription: Suggests a relevant published skill when your prompt matches one, searches the ss33 Skill Store with a short project summary (never source code), and installs skills as native SKILL.md files in .agents/skills, pinned in ss33.lock.
defaultPrompt: $ss33:search a skill for setting up CI in this project
